# Damn Delicious

> A recipe blog offering simple, delicious, and easy-to-follow recipes for everyday cooking, meal prep, and entertaining.

Founded by Chungah Rhee, Damn Delicious specializes in straightforward recipes using simple ingredients, complemented by step-by-step video tutorials and multiple published cookbooks. The site focuses on weeknight dinners, meal planning, comfort food, and quick recipes for home cooks of all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Easy Recipes
- Weeknight Dinners
- Comfort Food
- Meal Prep
- Quick Dinners
- Simple Ingredients
- One-Pot Meals
- Party Appetizers

## Core Recipe Resources

- [Recipe Index - Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/recipe-index): Comprehensive recipe index organizing recipes by category, ingredients, and cooking methods
- [Damn Delicious Recipes | Simple Delicious Food Recipes](https://damndelicious.net): Homepage featuring simple, delicious recipes for easy weeknight meals and everyday cooking
- [Easy, Step-by-Step Recipe Videos by Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/videos): Step-by-step video tutorials for easy recipes and cooking techniques with visual guidance

## Cookbooks & Collections

- [115 Meal Prep Recipes - Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/damn-delicious-meal-prep-115-easy-recipes-for-low-calorie-high-energy-living): Cookbook featuring 115 meal prep recipes for low-calorie, healthy eating and planning

## Featured Recipes

- [One Pot Garlic Butter Shrimp and Orzo - Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/2026/01/30/one-pot-garlic-butter-shrimp-and-orzo): Quick 40-minute one-pot meal with juicy shrimp and creamy garlic butter orzo
- [Easy Quiche - Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/2026/02/27/easy-quiche): Easiest homemade quiche using store-bought pie dough with creamy custard filling
- [Eggs in Purgatory - Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/2026/03/13/eggs-in-purgatory): Easy one-pan dish with eggs poached in savory garlic tomato sauce
- [Ravioli with Sun Dried Tomato Cream Sauce - Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/2025/12/19/ravioli-with-sun-dried-tomato-cream-sauce): 30-minute elegant ravioli with velvety sun dried tomato cream sauce for weeknight dinner
- [Guinness Beef Stew - Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/2025/02/21/guinness-beef-stew): Rich, flavorful Guinness beef stew recipe with tender meat and vegetables
- [No Yeast Bread - Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/2021/05/31/no-yeast-bread): Quick, easy homemade rustic bread recipe without yeast, proof, or rise time
- [Corned Beef and Cabbage - Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/2022/03/11/corned-beef-and-cabbage): St. Patrick's Day corned beef and cabbage recipe with roasted potatoes and carrots
- [Corned Beef Hash - Damn Delicious](https://damndelicious.net/2015/03/16/corned-beef-hash): No-fuss corned beef hash with crispy roasted potatoes for breakfast or dinner
